name: goshos-dock
description: goshos-dock is a macOS-like dock for the GNOME Shell. It moves the dash out of the overview and turns it into a dock for easier launching of applications and faster switching between windows and desktops, with optional icon magnification, Applications/Documents/Downloads/custom folder stacks and other macOS dock behaviours. Side and bottom placement options are available.
